name: issue_1705_occupant_off_still_clears_blower_flag
description: Blower install: the occupant switching the thermostat Off during CA's own blower circulation run still clears CA's stale blower flag (#89), after the #1705 narrowing
notes: Occupant: switching the thermostat Off at the wall while Climate Advisor's blower circulation run is marked active must not leave the dashboard claiming CA's fan is still running (Issue #89). #1705 narrowed that clear to a real change to Off (CA's own or the occupant's) with no economizer or nat-vent session owning the blower; this scenario pins that the occupant's own Off still qualifies.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the #89 clause in coordinator.py leaves _fan_active True and fails the 14:15 assertion; the scenario passes on the pre-fix code too (the occupant's cool -> off is a real change to Off). (b) docs-production: docs/fan-lifecycle-spec.md 'Thermostat Off Clears CA's Blower Flag Only on a Real Change to Off (Issue #1705)' says the occupant's real Off still clears the flag; production's _async_thermostat_changed does. (c) occupant: if this regressed, the Fan (HVAC) card would keep showing CA's blower 'active' after the occupant turned the system off, and status/suppression logic would trust a fan that is not CA's.

verdict.summary: Occupant Off clears CA's stale blower flag

events.note: Hot day: the cool band is armed (thermostat in cool).
CA's own circulation run starts the blower (not natural ventilation, not the economizer).
The occupant switches the thermostat Off at the wall while CA's blower session is marked active.

assertions.reason: The occupant's real cool -> off change, not commanded by CA and with no nat-vent or economizer session, clears CA's stale blower flag (#89).
Control: no economizer session is involved, so the economizer exemption does not apply.
